## 🛡️ Scams & safety alerts

- 🔴 ACTION NEEDED — **Fake ₹8,000 Government Bonus WhatsApp Scam**
  *How it works:* Scammers send WhatsApp messages claiming Prime Minister Narendra Modi is gifting an ₹8,000 Diwali bonus, containing links to fake bank forms. [[The Economic Times]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[ET Now]](https://news.google.?oc=5)
  *What to do:* Never click links promising cash gifts or bonuses; delete the message immediately. Government agencies never distribute cash via WhatsApp links. [[ET Now]](https://news.google.?oc=5)

- 🟡 DEVELOPING — **VOLTA AI Infostealer Malware Targets Financial Data**
  *How it works:* A new Windows malware named VOLTA uses AI models (Claude and Gemini) to scan infected computers and rank stolen credentials by financial value. [[The Hacker News]](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/new-volta-infostealer-uses-claude.html)
  *What to do:* Keep anti-virus software updated and avoid downloading unverified file attachments or software patches. [[The Hacker News]](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/new-volta-infostealer-uses-claude.html)

- 🟡 DEVELOPING — **Digital Arrest Fraud Claims ₹48 Lakh from Victims**
  *How it works:* Fraudsters posing as police or customs officials place video calls claiming the victim's ID was used in illegal packages, demanding money to cancel fake arrest warrants. [[The Times of India]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[ETV Bharat]](https://news.google.?oc=5)
  *What to do:* Hang up immediately. Indian police and law enforcement never demand money or conduct judicial arrests via video call. [[The Times of India]](https://news.google.?oc=5)

## 🎓 Today's lesson

- **What is Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) Tax?**
  LTCG tax is a levy imposed on profits earned from selling assets like stocks, mutual funds, or real estate held past a mandatory holding period (usually 1 year for Indian listed equities). When an investor buys shares for ₹1,000 and sells them a year later for ₹1,500, the ₹500 gain is subject to LTCG tax. SEBI's proposal to remove the 12.5% LTCG tax for foreign investors aims to make Indian stock markets more attractive compared to tax-free or lower-tax global trading destinations. [[Business Standard]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[VCCircle]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[The Times of India]](https://news.google.?oc=5)
